survey.text:
Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information

Use this form to opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information, or to request its deletion. An opt-out is honoured without asking you to confirm it by email; a deletion request gets an email with a link to confirm it. We do not discriminate against you for exercising your privacy rights. We honor opt-out of sale or sharing requests within 15 business days of receipt.
